title: Valid JSON with spaces, a tab, CRLF and another key order around "usage"
policy: P8: valid JSON is read whatever its whitespace or key order. P7: a usage record whose usage isn't an object can't be read and is reported; usage null is no usage. User records are ignored, whatever usage they quote or carry.
derivation: a "usage": { [10, 1]; b "usage" :{ [20, 2]; c tab [30, 3]; d CRLF [40, 4]; e spaces everywhere, usage first in message [50, 5]. f1 a user record quoting \"usage\" inside its text and f2 a user record carrying a usage object: ignored. g usage "n/a": can't be read, dated 16:06. h usage null: no usage, ignored. i a <synthetic> record and j a user record carrying usage, both without a timestamp: ignored, not undated. [150, 15, 0, 0, 0, 5] = 165. Today only d is read (44): the pre-filter needs the exact bytes "usage":{.
